cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import ref, main as impl, fuzz

# weird service tokens: whitespace, control escapes, quotes, backslashes, emoji, combining marks
names = ["a b", "with\ttab", "line\\nfeed", "q\"z", "back\\\\slash", "\ud83d\ude00", "é",
         "\u0000", "\u001f", " spaced ", "/", "\\\\u0041", "tab\tafter", "\u007f", "\u2028", "\ud83d\ude00x",
         "very long " + "y"*50]
services = names[:6]
atoms = [('contains', services[1:3]), ('startswith', (services[0],)), ('endswith', (services[4], services[5])), ('match', (services[3], services[3]))]
rules = [
  {'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for (_o,p) in atoms if _o=='contains']}},
  {'action':'drop','when':{'op':'and','args':[{'op':'endswith','path':list(atoms[2][1])},{'op':'not','arg':{'op':'true'}}]}},
  {'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':[{'op':'startswith','path':list(atoms[1][1])},{'op':'match','path':list(atoms[3][1])}]}},
]
rng = random.Random(3)
queries = []
for _ in range(30):
    n = rng.randint(0, 6)
    queries.append([rng.choice(services) for _ in range(n)])
req = {'services':services,'rules':rules,'queries':queries}
got = json.loads(impl.process(json.dumps(req).encode('utf-8')))
exp = ref.compile_reference(req)
print('weird tokens match:', got == exp)
assert got == exp
fuzz.check_dfa(req, got)
print('dfa states', len(got['dfa']['next']))
# long names and 64-scalar names
services2 = ['z'*64, 'a'*64, 'b']
req2 = {'services':services2,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'contains','path':['z'*30,'a'*64]}}],'queries':[[('z'*30),('a'*64)],['b']]}
got2 = json.loads(impl.process(json.dumps(req2).encode('utf-8')))
exp2 = ref.compile_reference(req2)
print('long names match:', got2 == exp2, 'states', len(got2['dfa']['next']))
fuzz.check_dfa(req2, got2)
EOF
